card.name: Arsenal Bug
card.officialEffect: If you control no other Insect-Type monsters, this card's ATK and DEF become 1000.

rulings.status: historical UDE/Edison ruling reference, not presented as a current Konami ruling
verifiedBehavior: the continuous effect applies while Arsenal Bug is face-up
a face-down Insect does not count as another Insect
two face-up Arsenal Bugs count each other and each remains at 2000 ATK

design.output: stat delta, not absolute replacement: -1000 ATK and -1000 DEF when the condition is true, so other Equip/Field modifiers can compose afterward
design.teamScope: TagDuel's shared team Monster Zones; a partner's face-up Insect counts
design.exclusions: the source itself, face-down monsters, opponent monsters, cards in hand/backrow/GY, and face-up non-Insects do not count
design.dynamic: recomputed from the current field every call; no persisted/cached modifier
design.typeChanges: caller may inject an effective race lookup so type-changing effects can be reflected; default lookup uses printed card metadata
design.negation: no modifier while Arsenal Bug's effect is negated
design.ownership: source UID physical seat must belong to the team whose shared Monster Zone contains it

tests: lone Arsenal Bug falls from 2000/2000 to 1000/1000
partner face-up Insect keeps it at 2000/2000
two Arsenal Bugs count each other
source face-down disables the continuous effect
effective Type lookup for type-changing effects
no cached modifier or adapter mutation

certification.reason: Adapter is not registered in the shared resolver or manifest; M61 handoff remains pending.

limitations: Structural TagDuel fixtures are used because Arsenal Bug is not yet registered in the shared playable-card catalog.
The helper is not wired into the continuous stat resolver; no certification is claimed.
A full integrated duel must confirm the team-wide interpretation against the project's final TagDuel rules and current race-changing effects.
Offline adapter tests do not replace live Discord validation.
